style: Kalinga architectural style (Rekha Deula and Pidha Jagamohana)
key_structures: Nabhi Gaya Kunda (sacred pit for offering Pinda)
Chausathi Yogini remnants and Varaha temple
special_features: Unique ancient two-armed (Dvi-bhuja) Mahishasuramardini idol spearing the demon while pulling the tail of the buffalo with left hand
Goddess mounts a lion with one foot resting on the subdued buffalo
Simhadwara (Lion Gate) facing the holy Vaitarani River
renovation_history: First established during the Gupta period; monumental stone temple built by Somavamshi King Yayati I in the 10th-11th century; renovated by Ganga rulers.
